entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I was thinking you might not show.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So, whose heart do you want us[n]to change?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...A mafia boss.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Mafia!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What're you talkin' about!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's what they call themselves. This[n]group seems to be the cause of the rise[n]in phishing scams.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What's worse, once you're in their sights,[n]they won't stop threatening you until[n]they get what they want.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: They'll force you to take part in their[n]scams, threaten your family, and[n]ultimately destroy your life.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Holy shit...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It appears that their victims include[n]some of our students.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: They primarily target juveniles.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What's their boss's name?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Nobody knows.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The victims are being threatened not[n]to testify, so even the police can't[n]get a grasp of the situation.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's where you want us to start!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You should be able to pull it off...[n]if you're really the righteous Phantom[n]Thieves.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Or is Akechi-kun correct when he says[n]you act without justice?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Can't you say something witty[n]back at her?
Please don't tell the cops.
Give us the details.
Something witty.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You totally let her win!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Why are you being so serious!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I knew you were gonna say that!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Their main hub of activity is in Shibuya...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's all the information I have.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You have two weeks.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Once that has passed, I'll submit all[n]the evidence I have to the police and[n]to the school.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I hope you don't let me down...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She really had the upper hand in that[n]exchange...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: "Don't let me down"... Dammit, she was[n]just bossin' us around...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Come on, we should get in touch with[n]Yusuke.
